title: Mathematical Analysis of Hallucination Dynamics in Large Language Models: Uncertainty Quantification, Advanced Decoding, and Principled Mitigation
why_relevant: Proposes a theoretical framework for hallucination mitigation including uncertainty quantification, abstention, and retrieval-augmented grounding, touching on calibration and control themes relevant to the survey.
why_not_or_caveat: Speculative, non-empirical theory paper with idiosyncratic phase-based formulations; not focused on RAG robustness specifically and lacks experimental validation.
